0.4.0.lead: nextasks now looks like the other nex apps, and Scheduled can show its days as columns.

sections.title: Scheduled as columns
sections.where: Scheduled, the sliders icon at the top right
sections.body: Switch between list and columns. In columns every day from today gets a column of its own, as many as fit side by side, with anything overdue in front. Drag a task to another day to move it; its time stays. The “+” under a column adds a task for that day. Each device remembers your choice.

sections.title: Settings in one place
sections.where: Your name at the bottom of the sidebar
sections.body: The menu above your name is gone. Clicking your name opens the settings: “My account” with profile, security, appearance, connections and notifications, “Server” for operators, and “About nextasks” at the bottom. Language and sign out are in the profile, light and dark under appearance.

sections.title: New task and search in the sidebar
sections.body: “+ New task” and the search now sit at the top of the sidebar. Drag its right edge to make the sidebar wider or narrower; a double click resets it.

sections.title: A calmer look
sections.body: Buttons, fields, menus, dialogs and notices look like those of the other nex apps. Lists carry a small symbol in their colour instead of a coloured tile. Before a list, a space or a filter is deleted, a dialog of its own asks first.

small: Bring a deleted task back right from the notice at the bottom with “Undo”.
New lists and filters come from the “+” in the head of a space or of the filters, a new space from a space’s “…” menu.
An unknown address or a deleted list now shows a note with the way to the start page instead of quietly jumping to Today.
Old bookmarks and links to My account and the settings lead to the new place.

0.3.2.lead: The nextasks mark now has a dark version.

sections.title: The mark in dark mode
sections.body: In dark mode the tick now sits on a dark tile in a lighter petrol instead of a white one. The browser tab follows your system. The iPhone app gets the same with its next update, where the app icon follows light, dark and tinted mode too.

small: The browser now asks before it uses the mark, the icons and the theme script again, and their addresses carry a version, so a new mark reaches an installed web app too.

0.3.1.lead: Repeating tasks no longer get stuck.

sections.title: Ticking off always works
sections.body: If you ticked off an occurrence and then set the date back to it by hand, the task could not be ticked off again: all you got was “Already done”. Now it moves on to its next occurrence as usual, without counting that occurrence as done twice.

small: In the iPhone app, a quick second tap no longer ticks off the next occurrence too (with the next app update).

0.3.0.lead: Connect your server on the iPhone once, and it is on your iPad too.

sections.title: Connection through iCloud to all your devices
sections.body: The iPhone app keeps the connection to your server in the iCloud Keychain. Your other devices with the same Apple ID take it over by themselves and sign in under their own name. Each one shows in your profile under devices and can be disconnected there on its own.

small: A device brings in at most five more an hour. An operator who switches off pairing new devices switches this off too.

0.2.1.lead: Important tasks stand out more on the iPhone.

sections.title: High priority is time-sensitive
sections.body: When a task with high priority falls due, the server sends the priority along. The iPhone app then shows the notification as time-sensitive: it stays at the top of the lock screen and gets through Focus and the scheduled summary.

small: Older iPhone apps skip the priority that comes along; for them nothing changes.

0.2.0.lead: Own filters: put together what you want to see, and hide what you do not need.

sections.title: Own filters
sections.body: A filter gathers tasks by your conditions: open or completed, due today or in the next 7 days, completed today, from certain spaces or lists, marked, assigned to you or someone else, by priority or tag. All chosen conditions must match. Each filter has a name, colour and symbol and sits in the sidebar below the collections.

sections.title: The sidebar the way you like it
sections.body: The eye shows or hides each collection (Today, Scheduled, All and so on) and each own filter. It applies to all your devices, the iPhone app included.

sections.title: Many more symbols
sections.where: Edit a space, list or filter
sections.body: 259 symbols in groups instead of 46, with a search in English and German: “dog” finds the dog, “fridge” the fridge.

small: “There is a new version” only shows when there really is one.
With Today hidden, nextasks starts on the first collection still shown.

0.1.0.lead: nextasks is rebuilt: tasks for families and small groups, in the browser, installable as an app, and with an iPhone app.

sections.title: Collections, spaces and lists
sections.body: At the top the collections Today, Scheduled, All, Marked, Assigned to me and Completed, below them your spaces with their lists. A space you do not need can be hidden from its menu; it then counts nowhere until you show it again.

sections.title: Tasks and notes
sections.where: Click a task, or New task at the top
sections.body: A task opens as a card in the middle; the button at the end of its row shows it in a column on the right instead. Notes are written with bold, lists, checklists and pictures, without any marks to learn. A right click opens a menu wherever there is something to do.

sections.title: Together with others
sections.body: Invite family or friends to a space with a link or by mail and assign tasks to one or more people. One is enough: whoever completes it first completes it for everyone.

sections.title: Notifications and reports
sections.body: One table says what reaches you by mail, in the browser or on the iPhone: tasks assigned to you, tasks that are due, changes in lists you follow, and the reports “My day” and “Weekly report”.

small: Quick entry with Shift+N: “Milk tomorrow 9am #groceries !!” sets date, time, tag and priority.
Install nextasks as an app from the account menu; it says when there is a new version.
An API for programs (docs/api.md), columns per section, subtasks, repetitions in words, a trash for 30 days, light and dark.
